propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeGasSensor
propertySets.definition: A device that senses or detects gas. HISTORY: Changed in IFC4. Gas detected made into enumeration, set point concentration and coverage area added. Range, accuracy and time constant deleted.

properties.name: GasDetected
properties.definition: Identification of the gas that is being detected, according to chemical formula.  For example, carbon monoxide is 'CO', carbon dioxide is 'CO2', oxygen is 'O2'.

properties.name: SetPointConcentration
properties.definition: The concentration to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

properties.name: CoverageArea
properties.definition:
The area that is covered by the object.

Floor area (typically measured as a circle whose center is at the location of the sensor).
